notes.title: Version update & optimize experience & fix BUG
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428356/00a71f05baeaffc31b1b321762b2ff4e95bd5bb4.png


 Updated the ability to predict enemy actions during battle
(I think this feature is super cool!)

 Optimized the playback speed and effects of the text to make it smoother
(After receiving feedback from everyone, I feel that it really needs to be optimized)

 Fixed a bug where some texts were displayed incorrectly
([strike]I don't know what it does, but the bug seems to mysteriously disappear[/strike])

 Fixed an issue where localized translations were not displaying correctly
(It's hidden too deep, and it's not the reason I wasn't careful enough...)

 Fixed an issue where display errors occurred when switching resolutions
(My brain is attacking me and telling me how to fix it...)


Thank you very much for your support
